name: core
description: v2.64.0 (2026-08-02) - Sutra UI: local governance panel (FastAPI + Electron shell) from PR #85, shipped with security hardening. Websocket handshakes on /ws/chat and /ws/term now reject non-loopback Origins before accept() and TrustedHostMiddleware blocks DNS rebinding; agent-permission modes that auto-approve (acceptEdits, bypassPermissions) require SUTRA_UI_ALLOW_UNSAFE_PERM_MODES=1 and are clamped at the point of use, not only where they are written; agent workdir is confined to $HOME (SUTRA_UI_WORKDIR_ROOT to widen); openExternal restricted to http(s); npx --no-install; fixture_seed refuses the live registry. 14 new guard tests; 146 tests green. + v2.40.0 (2026-07-20) - D63: per-turn governance stack HARD fleet-wide. New Stop floor per-turn-hard-gate.sh floors Input Routing + Depth on no-tool turns; codex-consult-gate.sh at Depth>=3 degrades to pass without the codex binary; /core:start contract expanded 4->9 blocks, gated behind onboarding so enforcement never precedes the contract. + v2.39.20 (2026-07-08) - Testlify field-incident fix: blueprint-check.sh HARD-blocked Write even after a correct prose BLUEPRINT, because the hook reads ONLY the .claude/blueprint-registered marker and no fleet-visible surface said to write it — the model's only advertised exit (BLUEPRINT_ACK=1, unusable on Write calls) taught a Bash bypass of the gate. per-turn-discipline-prompt.sh now states the marker contract (write the marker via the Write tool with HAS_OUTPUT/HAS_VERIFY/HAS_PER_STEP_VERIFY) before the first Edit/Write of each turn, and blueprint-check.sh gains an out-of-repo guard: absolute paths outside $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR (e.g. ~/.claude/** memory files, sibling repos) are out of scope — they could never match any whitelist and were blocked by accident. Inside-repo enforcement unchanged; tests 6/6. (#78 depth-gate + error-text split ships separately; A4 text-validation via #73.) + v2.39.19 (2026-07-06) - #63 fix: /core:start now DOCUMENTS the H-Sutra header contract it enforces — the header format (DIRECTION/VERB/TIMING/CHANNEL/REV/RISK) is written into CLAUDE.md as its own section, closing the invisible-rule gap that caused repeated 'redo with the header' blocks. After update, re-run /core:start to regenerate the block. (A4 block-text validation ships separately via #73.) + v2.39.18 (2026-06-30) - loop-budget-guard per-turn reset + agent-orchestration exemption: fixes the session-wide 'tool-budget guard hard-stopped further file reads' deadlock. The guard's call counter was cumulative-per-session and never reset, so a long working session crossed the 250 ceiling on ordinary Bash/Read/Write calls and hard-stopped itself. New loopguard-turn-reset.sh (UserPromptSubmit) truncates the counter at the start of each real user turn (budget is now per-turn; a 250-call runaway in one turn still blocks; synthetic turns skipped). Agent/Task/Workflow dispatches are exempt (a fan-out is not a loop). (A4 block-text validation lands separately via PR #73.) Operating system for building with AI. See CHANGELOG.md.
